description: This file defines interfaces and utility classes for interacting with EGL and OpenGL ES 2.0, including extension handling, error stringification, and debug utilities within the Thunder::Compositor namespace.

classes.name: Attributes
classes.description: Template class for managing EGL attribute lists with convenient append and access methods.

classes.name: GL
classes.description: Class providing static methods for error stringification, shader/program info logs, and renderer detection, as well as function pointers for OpenGL ES extensions.

classes.name: EGL
classes.description: Class providing static methods for error stringification, extension querying, and function pointers for EGL extensions.

methods.name: ErrorString
methods.description: Converts GLenum or EGLint error codes to human-readable strings.

methods.name: HasExtension
methods.description: Checks if a specific extension is present in a space-separated extension string.

methods.name: ShaderInfoLog
methods.description: Retrieves the info log for a shader handle.

methods.name: ProgramInfoLog
methods.description: Retrieves the info log for a program handle.

methods.name: HasRenderer
methods.description: Checks if the current renderer matches a given name.

methods.name: HasClientAPI
methods.description: Checks if a specific client API is supported by the EGL display.
